title: Machine Learning Guided Assembly of a Nested Gd20@Gd32@Ni36 Cluster via Urea Controlled Carbonate Release

synthesis.procedure: Add 1.0 mL of a mixed aqueous solution containing 0.5 M H2MeIDA and 0.5 M Ni(NO3)2, 1.0 mL of 1 M aqueous Gd(ClO4)3, 1.0 mL of 1 M aqueous NaOH, and 0.4 mL of 1 M aqueous urea to 3.6 mL acetonitrile. Heat at 80 °C for 3 d, then evaporate the reaction mixture at room temperature to obtain blue crystals.

reagents.name: N-Methyliminodiacetic acid
reagents.amount: 0.5 M in 1.0 mL mixed aqueous H2MeIDA/Ni(NO3)2 solution

reagents.name: Nickel(II) nitrate
reagents.amount: 0.5 M in 1.0 mL mixed aqueous H2MeIDA/Ni(NO3)2 solution

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporation at room temperature yielded blue crystals.

properties.summary: Magnetic circular dichroism under an external field showed signals attributed to Ni(II) d–d transitions; no observable Gd(III) f–f transitions were identified in the visible-to-near-infrared region. No separate bulk magnetic measurement is reported.

measurements.name: Magnetic circular dichroism
measurements.conditions: Dissolved in water; room temperature; 1.6 T magnetic field

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Gd20 inner shell is a carbonate-templated dodecahedron; a Gd32 middle shell and Ni36 outer shell form two approximately cube-like layers. Bridging hydroxides connect the concentric shells.

material_class.structural_family: Samarium–nickel analogue of the nested polyhedral cluster

synthesis.procedure: Follow the Gd52Ni36 preparation, replacing its 1.0 mL of 1 M aqueous Gd(ClO4)3 with 1.0 mL of 1 M aqueous Sm(ClO4)3. Add the same mixed aqueous H2MeIDA/Ni(NO3)2 solution, aqueous NaOH and urea to acetonitrile; heat at 80 °C for 3 d and evaporate at room temperature.

reagents.name: N-Methyliminodiacetic acid
reagents.amount: 0.5 M in 1.0 mL mixed aqueous H2MeIDA/Ni(NO3)2 solution

reagents.name: Nickel(II) nitrate
reagents.amount: 0.5 M in 1.0 mL mixed aqueous H2MeIDA/Ni(NO3)2 solution

reagents.name: Samarium(III) perchlorate
reagents.amount: 1.0 mL of 1 M aqueous solution, substituted for Gd(ClO4)3

synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution reaction following the Gd52Ni36 procedure with metal-source substitution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporation of the heated reaction mixture at room temperature.

properties.summary: Magnetic circular dichroism showed Ni(II) d–d and distinct Sm(III) f–f transitions. Field reversal changed the spectra. No separate bulk magnetic measurement is reported.

measurements.name: Sm(III) MCD peak
measurements.conditions: Water solution; room temperature; 1.6 T; assigned to 6H5/2 → 4L13/2

measurements.name: Maximum MCD g-factor attributed to Sm(III)

source_locations.location: Sm52Ni36 preparation and crystallographic Table S4

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The article calls this the Sm52Ni36 analogue. Its SI preparation formula additionally specifies six [Sm(H2O)3] units, giving 58 Sm atoms and 36 Ni atoms in the reported crystallographic composition; the compound label should not be read as its total Sm count.
